text:
incident-bot: Page triggered: router_p95_latency > 1200ms (svc=runtime-router, region=us-west-2)
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-8421 created and notified oncall
maria: ack — I’m on it :raised_hand: seeing a spike in p95 across a subset of routers
kevin: thx — grabbing logs from the router pool, could be a short kv-warmup storm, starting `kubectl logs -l app=runtime-router -n prod --tail=200`
sam: any customer-facing alerts / support tickets yet?
maria: no tickets in zendesk, and front-door synthetic checks green. Likely no user impact, but p95 for some tenants spiked to ~1.5s.
kevin: logs show a flurry of long tail GC-ish pauses on 3 pods, but CPU/ram normal. attaching log snippet:
```
2026-03-15T10:12:03Z router-7f9b: op=dispatch latency=1523ms kv_cache_miss=1 seq=2048
2026-03-15T10:12:04Z router-b2c1: op=dispatch latency=1489ms kv_cache_miss=1 seq=2051
2026-03-15T10:12:05Z router-9a1d: op=dispatch latency=1602ms kv_cache_miss=0 seq=2050
```
maria: those kv_cache_miss flags line up with a background KV invalidation job that started at 10:11:50 — maybe a rolling warmup / rehydrate kicked off.
pagerduty-bot: PD-8421: Acknowledged by maria
kevin: I’m going to throttle the invalidation job on staging and watch prod metrics — putting a short temporary rate limit: `curl -X POST https://infra/api/invalidation/rate -d '{"limit":50}'`
sam: @maria want a hand with the PD escalation / customer comms if this doesn’t clear in 10m?
maria: thanks, I’ll hold. If this clears we’ll let PD auto-resolve and file a follow-up.
incident-bot: Alert auto-resolved: router_p95_latency back under threshold at 10:14:20 — PD incident PD-8421 auto-resolved
kevin: nice, metrics back to baseline. looks like warmup burst finished. Confirming across regions: us-east normal, us-west spike only.
sam: no customer impact observed, no error increases in front-end logs. 👍
maria: marking as transient; will add runbook note: consider smoothing invalidation windows and add metric guard so single-region warmups don’t trigger global PD.
kevin: opening a follow-up ticket: INFRA-1298 to add rate-limits + dashboard annotation; assigning to infra-scheduling.
maria: quick checklist for handoff:
- Incident: PD-8421 transient p95 spike due to KV warmup in us-west-2
- Impact: no customer-facing errors, latency spike for internal p95 only
- Action taken: acked, throttled invalidation, observed auto-resolve
- Next steps: INFRA-1298 (rate-limit invalidation), add synthetic to cover this pattern
kevin: leaving a note in PD that service was healthy on canary pool, nothing to roll back.
sam: if this repeats let's enable a narrow suppress rule for that alert to require both p95 and error-rate > 0.5% before paging.
maria: agreed. I’ll hand off to kevin for follow-up; I’m back to other oncall tasks. thanks team :thumbsup:
kevin: taking the action items — will ping infra leads and close the ticket when done.
incident-bot: Handed off oncall to kevin at 10:20:00
pagerduty-bot: PD-8421 closed (auto-resolve)
maria: closing thread — tag INFRA-1298 in the oncall notes and link to logs: https://logs.redwood/prod/router/us-west-2/6578901234
kevin: noted, will post postmortem-lite if we see recurrence.
